answer.instructions: Which team should handle this customer message?

criteria.billing: Charges, invoices, refunds, payment methods and discount codes
criteria.technical: The website or app not working: crashes, errors, login and broken pages
criteria.shipping: Delivery, couriers, tracking, delivery dates and lost parcels
